summary_en: This study tests pembrolizumab given with melphalan and dactinomycin, which are delivered directly to the affected arm or leg by isolated limb infusion (ILI), in patients with extremity sarcoma. Pembrolizumab is given into a vein at 200 mg on Day 1 and every 3 weeks, and the ILI procedure is done within 18 days after pembrolizumab starts. The study aims to learn whether the treatment is safe and can delay disease progression; the primary outcome measure is not stated, and it is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa pembrolizumab administrado junto con melfalán y dactinomicina, que se aplican directamente en el brazo o la pierna afectados mediante perfusión aislada de extremidad (ILI), en pacientes con sarcoma de extremidad. El pembrolizumab se administra en una vena a 200 mg el Día 1 y cada 3 semanas, y el procedimiento ILI se realiza dentro de los 18 días posteriores al inicio del pembrolizumab. El estudio busca saber si el tratamiento es seguro y si puede retrasar la progresión de la enfermedad; la medida de resultado principal no está indicada, y es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Age 12 years or older at the time of consent
Histologically confirmed metastatic and/or locally advanced sarcoma
Eligible for standard pembrolizumab and for isolated limb infusion as judged by the treating physician
Prior at least one line of systemic therapy, or declined the standard systemic option
Measurable disease per RECIST 1.1 or clinical measurement, and ECOG 2 or less or KPS 60% or more
not_for: Another malignancy that requires active treatment
Known active brain metastases or sarcomatous meningitis (some treated, stable brain metastases allowed)
Autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years
Known active hepatitis B or C, or active tuberculosis
Pregnant or breast-feeding, or planning pregnancy
